Name: (CP) (AT) Chinese Style Architecture
Author: CiChangAn
Description:
[b][color=#e69138][size=4]* 介绍 *[/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=3]*introduce *[/size][/color]
[/b]
[color=#e69138][size=3]这是一个季节性的中式建筑替换mod，它替换了玩家的房屋。[/size][/color]
[size=2]This is a seasonal Chinese building replacement mod that replaces the player's house.[/size]

[color=#e69138][size=3]由于建筑所处在的朝代与使用的制式并未详细考究，我无法给它取更实际的名称，所以只能将它泛指为一座中式建筑。[/size][/color]
[size=2]Since the dynasty in which the building is located and the system used are not detailed, I cannot give it a more practical name, so I can only refer to it as a Chinese building in general.[/size]
[color=#e69138]
[size=3]大家下载前请务必阅读使用说明。[/size][/color]
Please read the instructions before downloading.



————————————————————————————————————
[b]
[color=#6aa84f][size=4]* 使用方式 *[/size][/color]
[size=3]* How to use *[/size][/b]
[color=#93c47d]

[size=3]确保下载了 [b]SMAPI 、[/b] [b]ContentPatcher [/b]和[b] Alternative Textures[/b]。[/size][/color]
[size=2]Make sure to download [b]SMAPI、[/b][b]ContentPatcher [/b]and[b] [b]Alternative Textures[/b][/b].[/size]


[color=#93c47d]我制作了[/color][color=#6aa84f][b]CP版本[/b]和[b]AT版本[/b]：[/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=2]I made [b]CP version [/b]and [b]AT version:[/b][/size][/color]


[color=#93c47d][size=3] [b]CP版[/b]（有两种文件，请根据自身的需要下载，两份文件无法同时使用）[/size][/color]
[b] CP [b]version[/b][/b] （There are two types of files, please download according to your own needs, the two files cannot be used at the same time）

[color=#93c47d][size=3]1.[CP]Chinese Style Architecture - High saturation，适配于原游戏的[b]高饱和度[/b]。[/size][/color]
1.[CP]Chinese Style Architecture - High saturation，[b]high saturation[/b] for the original game.

[color=#93c47d][size=3] 2.[CP]Chinese Style Architecture - Low saturation，适配于滤镜mod的[b]低饱和度[/b]。[/size][/color]
2.[CP]Chinese Style Architecture - Low saturation，[b]low saturation[/b] for filter mods.

[color=#93c47d][size=3][color=#93c47d][size=3] 下载mod，将文件解压后放入mod文件夹里。[/size][/color]
[/size][/color][size=2]Download the mod, unzip the files and put them in the mod folder.[/size]



[b][color=#93c47d][size=3] AT[/size][/color][/b][color=#93c47d][size=3][b]版[/b][/size][/color]
[b] AT version[/b]

[color=#93c47d][size=3][color=#93c47d][size=3] 下载mod，将文件解压后放入mod文件夹里。[/size][/color]
[/size][/color][size=2] Download the mod, unzip the files and put them in the mod folder.[/size]
[color=#93c47d][size=3]
进入游戏后，前往木匠罗宾处购买油漆桶，左键对房屋使用即可。[/size][/color]
After entering the game, find Robin the carpenter to buy a paint bucket, left click on the house to use.
